# What does this drink actually cost you to pour?

> Free pour cost calculator for bars and restaurants: price a cocktail from your own bottle costs and pour sizes, see the liquor cost percentage against your target, and find out what over-pouring is really costing you a year. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
